justification: Both surfaces show relief animals in strict profile — notably a striding quadruped (canid-like, legs articulated and shown separately) placed above a smaller elongated creature — stacked in vertical registers across the broad flat face of a pillar, with the same convention of raised silhouette bodies and minimal internal detail. The clearest difference is that A additionally carries a row of repeated bird figures along the top and a horizontal patterned band with hatched/zigzag filling plus several further creatures (long-beaked bird, boar-like animal), making it a denser multi-register composition, whereas B shows only two or three isolated creatures on a largely empty field.
